name: @supernovaio/exporter-tailwind
description: Export your design system tokens into Tailwind CSS configuration using Supernova.io export engine

scripts.dev:export: nodemon --watch dist/build.js --exec 'cd ../.. && rm -rf tokens && supernova run-local-exporter --apiKey="$SUPERNOVA_API_KEY" --designSystemId=843306 --brandId=32422235-3f31-4ce4-9bba-755f00772a08 --themeId=ad2dbd55-c140-4e60-a67d-ba79b4e6846e,f2acf065-f100-40c9-a50d-8a9e20a8e5de --exporterDir=./exporters/tailwind-4 --outputDir=./tokens --allowOverridingOutput'
scripts.watch: concurrently --names build,export --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev" "npm run dev:export"

author: Supernova.io
